headline: The clap trend for the last three days of the year: cuts land on every clap, the most joyful people first, and no text from us. Sydney adds hers later.
story: The clap rhythm is the hook: the first clap lands on frame 1, then one clip per clap, cut exactly on the clap, the way the reference reel does it.
Loops and stakes come from Sydney's own text, which she adds after we deliver. Leave the middle of the frame clean for it.
End on the strongest clap or reaction, then Sydney's holiday end slide with no text.
do: Watch the reference reel first. Copy its structure, rhythm and length.
First clap on frame 1. No lead-in, no fade.
Cut exactly on every clap. Best, most joyful people first.
Leave the middle of the frame clean for Sydney's text.
If the reel uses a trending song, deliver claps and natural sound only and say so in the Frame.io comment.
dont: No text from us, not even at 0:00. Sydney adds it.
No logo at 0:00 and no extra logo on the end slide: the wordmark is already on it.
No trending song we cannot license.
No Christmas imagery. Holiday vibes only.
bp_intro: Picture: the 8 clap clips (Drive copy of Canto N7BL3). No shot list exists for them yet, and the row times are placeholders: the reference reel sets the real length and rhythm. No text and no motion graphics from us: Sydney adds her own text later.

End of Year runs 2 to 31 December. Goal: 5,000 kids with new shoes. This video posts 29 to 31 December.
Sydney's holiday end slide: V1 light blue or V2 dark blue. 1081×1921 JPG, 9:16. The SOLES4SOULS wordmark is already at the top. Put the CTA text in the open middle. No extra logo.
S4S graphics package (Drive). Same folder as the end slides. Type the words on the empty plates in Roboto. The logo files there are for end cards only; this campaign's end card is the holiday slide.
S4S teal #62CCBF, black, white, off-white #F8FAF9. Titles in Buenos Aires (Roboto Black if you do not have it), body in Roboto. Black text on teal. Never white on teal.
tech: Phone clips (MOV) from Canto. Sizes and frame rates are not probed yet: check each on import.
1080×1920 at 23.976 fps (24p, Nick's brief). Conform 30 and 60 fps clips on purpose.
Vertical clips: no crop. Horizontal clips: center-crop to 9:16 with the person in frame.
The claps are the soundtrack. A trending song from the reel is not ours to use: note it in the Frame.io comment so Sydney adds it in Instagram.
−14 LUFS integrated, −1 dBTP peak. Claps even, no clipping.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920. A clean master with no text. Upload to Frame.io with the Edit Key in the file name.
checklist: The first clap lands on frame 1. No lead-in, no fade.
Every cut lands on a clap.
No text anywhere in the master.
The middle of the frame stays clean for Sydney's text.
Ends on Sydney's holiday slide with no text and no extra logo.
Audio is licensed (or claps only), levels even, no clipping.
client_note: Why this matters: This is the last push of the year (29 to 31 Dec). Sydney adds her own text, so the cut has to leave room for it.
